our_interpretation: Assess the relationship depicted in the contemporary Journal chart, including its Q2 projection, rather than treating that projection as an actual result.
The ordinary reading is that costs previously grew roughly in proportion to revenue, with a departure in projected Q2 2026. Merely increasing together would not establish this.
Use 2025 through Q2 2026, reflecting the reference to last year and the expressly identified second quarter.
Treat the insinuation of suspicious accounting separately from the numerical pattern.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable quarterly figures in the cited chart show broadly proportional cost and revenue growth before Q2 2026, followed by materially slower projected cost growth in Q2.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable figures show material departures from proportional growth before Q2, or do not show the asserted Q2 departure.
